THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
102
STUDY 080
Argyle Cape Cardigan & Newsboy Cap
Rights check
Source: 24981.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark hair wears a
black newsboy cap and a gray button-front knit top with
a cropped argyle cape collar. She wears low-rise dark
wash jeans and a slim leather belt with a square gold
buckle. A black jacket hangs over one arm. Her
expression is calm and direct. A pink floral wallpaper
backdrop and a wooden stool, with warm soft light.
Palette of gray, black, and blush pink. Preppy and
vintage, in the style of a retro knitwear editorial.
Preppy, vintage, playful
WORKING NOTES
- The argyle cape and cap are the signature styling.
- Keep the floral wallpaper for a vintage interior mood.
